content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen works well, but the hours timeline stretches long without hour labels and the oversized footer wordmark repeats the name right above the small contact block.","desktopNote":"Hero and sections are handsome, but a dead white band sits under the hero and the menu occupies only the left 800px, leaving the right half of the screen empty.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Desktop: use the empty right half of the menu section for the pastry photo or the potica call-out, and trim the white band below the hero so the hours section starts closer.","Phone: compress the hours timeline (add hour ticks or switch to a compact list) and shrink the giant footer wordmark so the address and phone are reached sooner.","Fix the headline line breaks so 'drožmi,' doesn't sit alone on a line in both viewports."],"blockers":[]}
